title: Successor-machine components
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer and choose one of its work tapes. For each phase, assign a machine with the corresponding phase-dependent control data: the incrementing phase uses the Boolean increment machine, the extending phase uses the append-symbol machine with symbol true, and the exiting phase uses a one-state machine that leaves the input head and all work tapes unchanged, emits no output, and stays in its sole state.
